rationales.1: The lede states the full finding with numbers, the then-and-now ink columns restate it as plain figures, and the annotated notes under the chart plus the complete table make the conclusion reachable with no chart decoding or interaction.
rationales.2: The drift chart is named by its finding, uses an honest September-to-October day scale, draws the three missing years as open bands that no average crosses, and marks 2019 as a hollow dot.
rationales.3: Gaps, the 1996 to 1997 seam, the unverified 2019 reading, and the shift-not-cause scope note are all present and repeated at every crossing point; the two-ink device makes the instrument caveat structural rather than a footnote.
rationales.4: Patient, local, and concrete throughout, with one archival fragment per ink era placed exactly where it serves the record; the prose layer is slightly thinner than the best candidate here.
rationales.5: Serif editorial typography with comfortable measure and steady rhythm holds up in both modes and both viewports; the mobile drift chart is somewhat vertically compressed.
rationales.6: The page is a fully readable linear document with no visible scroll-driven apparatus or forced pacing; motion parity itself is not observable in static renders.
rationales.7: Printed in two inks is a one-sentence signature that the stat columns, the chart, the table ink, and even the quote attributions all reinforce, and it is the data-honesty story itself.
rationales.8: One deliberate device, the ink conceit, sits on otherwise wholly conventional reading mechanics, and the About section explains the break explicitly.
rationales.9: Unsensational and specific with lines like the record keeping human time as well as rain; a touch of the register still reads as designable house style rather than one paper's only voice.
rationales.10: Every device traces to a real feature of the dataset: inks to the instrument seam, bands to the true gaps, the hollow dot to the flagged reading; nothing is decoration detached from reporting.
